# Audio licences

Every sound a product video can carry, with its evidence. Owner rule: commercial use and
redistribution, recorded as each asset lands. A public-domain composition is not a public-domain
recording.

## Bundled or generated by default

| asset | source | licence | evidence | date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The score (voice-led pads, bass line, sub pulse, plucks, brushed ticks, hi-hat ticks, the payoff riser, the resolved end chord) | synthesised per video by `scripts/sound.py` `compose()`, from code in this plugin | original work of this plugin, MIT with the plugin | no samples, no downloads: every waveform is a sine, a sum of sines or seeded noise built in `sound.py` | 2026-10-07 |
| Sound effects: click, tick, whoosh, swell, hit | synthesised by `scripts/sound.py` `sfx_*()` | original work of this plugin, MIT with the plugin | same as above | 2026-10-06 |
| Reverb | a decaying noise impulse built in `sound.py` `reverb_ir()` | original work | same | 2026-10-06 |

Nothing is bundled as an audio file. Nothing is downloaded.

## Evaluated, not used

| option | terms (read 2026-10-06) | why not |
|---|---|---|
| Kenney "Interface Sounds" (100 files) | CC0 1.0, https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds, `License.txt`: "Creative Commons Zero, CC0 ... free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects" | Allowed, but the clicks are 10 ms game blips (click_002-005 measure 0.010 s). The synthesised click (tap + body + thock + short room) is closer to Linear's UI ticks. Can be added later with this row as its record. |
| Sonniss GDC bundles, Epidemic, Artlist, Pixabay music | redistribution forbidden or Content-ID'd | bring-your-own only, never bundled |

## User-supplied (never bundled)

| option | terms | what the user carries |
|---|---|---|
| ElevenLabs Music (`--music eleven`, the user's own key, $0.15 a minute, 2026-07) | Eleven Music Model-Specific Terms, last updated 2026-05-26, https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-model-specific-terms: "All online and offline commercial use permitted, except film, TV, radio, & Studio Games" on self-serve plans; resale and redistribution prohibited on self-serve; attribution required on the free plan | the track lives in their project's `audio/`, never in this repo; fine for a social or site video, not a TV spot |
| Their own track (`--music audio/<file>`) | theirs | they own or licensed it |
